name: tf3
prompt:
Append two exported functions to the END of web/src/views/deppicker.ts (keep everything that is there). They work on the DOM that depPicker() renders: .dep-chip li elements (each with data-id, the hidden attribute when not chosen, and an <input name="deps"> that is disabled when not chosen), .dep-option li elements (data-id, data-title = lower-case title, hidden when not shown), one .dep-none li, and the #dep-search input.

/** Shows the options that are not chosen and contain the query (case-insensitive). */
export function filterDeps(picker: HTMLElement, query: string): void
- q = query.trim().toLowerCase(); count the shown options.
- for each picker.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(".dep-option") o: chosen = the chip picker.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.dep-chip[data-id="${CSS.escape(o.dataset.id ?? "")}"]`) exists and is not hidden; o.hidden = chosen || !(o.dataset.title ?? "").includes(q).
- the .dep-none element: hidden = (shown > 0).

/** Chooses (on) or drops (off) one task, then clears the search and puts the caret back in it. */
export function setDep(picker: HTMLElement, id: string, on: boolean): void
- chip = picker.querySelector<HTMLElement>(`.dep-chip[data-id="${CSS.escape(id)}"]`); return when there is none.
- chip.hidden = !on; its input[name="deps"]: disabled = !on.
- the #dep-search input: value = "" and focus().
- then filterDeps(picker, "").
No other changes; no new imports are needed.
